messages:
Noah M: Following up on the postmortem - splitting action items so owners can pick them. We saw a recurring pattern (rate-limiter misconfig + gradual heap growth) across three recent incidents. Please claim items, add Jira links, and note RACI + handoff steps here.

Priya S: I can take the rate-limiter remediation (thresholds + backpressure). Will open a Jira and add acceptance criteria and a perf test harness.

Riley T: Ill own the memory leak investigation and patch (probable exporter goroutine). Will attach flamegraphs to the ticket.

Noah M: Great. Proposed tickets: INF-3910 = rate-limiter config + tests (Priya), INF-3911 = leak root-cause + fix (Riley), INF-3912 = runbook + alerts tuning (SRE Ops + me).

Priya S: INF-3910 created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3910. Acceptance: sustained 5m P95 latency < 120ms under 2x baseline load; backpressure avoids request retries. ETA Fri.

Riley T: INF-3911 created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3911. Ive uploaded heap profiles and a failing repro. ETA next Wed.

SRE Ops: Well take INF-3912 for alert tuning and runbook edits. Will add a follow-up JIRA board card and schedule a 1hr runbook review session.

Noah M: RACI template suggestion: Responsible = ticket owner, Accountable = SRE lead (Noah), Consulted = Platform/QA, Informed = Support/Product. Example: INF-3911 R:Riley, A:Noah, C:Priya/QA, I:Support.

Priya S: Added RACI to INF-3910 and linked the perf harness repo. Smoke test command for quick validation:
```
./perf-load --concurrency=200 --duration=300 --target=scheduler-service
# pass if p95 < 120ms and error-rate < 0.5%
```

Riley T: For the leak fix, handoff plan: (1) patch PR -> (2) QA smoke -> (3) staged canary for 48h in eu-west -> (4) escalate rollback if mem growth resumes. Ill update INF-3911 with that checklist.

SRE Ops: Request: please mark canary windows in the oncall calendar and ping @eng-oncall 24h before. We had overlap with infra maintenance last run.

Priya S: Will add a calendar invite for the rate-limiter canary and cc @eng-oncall.

Noah M: Decision on recurring audits: create a quarterly "regression audit" ticket chain owned by SRE Ops to run smoke suites and validate alerts. Riley/Priya to share smoke test playbooks.

SRE Ops: Confirmed - INF-3950 created as a recurring audit umbrella and linked to the three tickets. Will run first audit after fixes are in canary.

Riley T: Minor note on handoffs: after my PR merges, Ill assign INF-3911 to QA for smoke. Once QA signs off, hand to SRE Ops for canary monitoring and final close.

Priya S: Same flow for INF-3910: Ill own until QA sign-off, then Noah/SRE Ops do canary.

Noah M: Ok folks - please update the remediation sheet (link in PM doc) with ticket, owner, due date, and status. Ill run a quick checkpoint on Friday to make sure no blockers.

InfraBot: Automated note - 3 related incidents matched by signature. Added incident IDs and stack traces to postmortem doc.

QA Bot: Added QA owners to INF-3910 and INF-3911 and scheduled smoke runs after PRs land.

Noah M: Thanks. If anything shifts, post updates here and ping me. Closing this thread after Friday checkpoint. :thumbsup:
